rules.title: Allowable Annual Rent Increase
rules.requirement: For rent-controlled units, the allowable annual rent increase is 1.6% for March 1, 2026 – February 28, 2027.
rules.coverage_text: Units subject to the San Francisco Rent Board's allowable annual increase.

rules.title: Relocation Payments for Owner/Relative Move-in, Demolition/Removal, Temporary Capital Improvement, or Substantial Rehabilitation Evictions
rules.requirement: For eviction notices served 3/01/26 – 2/28/27 based on owner/relative move-in, demolition/permanent removal, temporary capital improvement work, or substantial rehabilitation, the relocation amount is $8,245.00 per tenant, up to $24,733.00 per unit, plus $5,497.00 for each elderly (60 years or older) or disabled tenant or household with minor child(ren).
rules.key_value: $8,245.00 per tenant; maximum $24,733.00 per unit; plus $5,497.00 per elderly/disabled tenant or household with minor child(ren)
rules.coverage_text: Tenants evicted for owner/relative move-in, demolition/permanent removal of unit from housing use, temporary capital improvement work, or substantial rehabilitation.
rules.exemptions: Relocation payments for temporary capital improvement evictions for less than 20 days are governed by California Civil Code Section 1947.9 instead.
rules.quoted_span: Relocation Payments for Evictions based on Owner/Relative Move-in OR Demolition/Permanent Removal of Unit from Housing Use OR Temporary Capital Improvement Work* OR Substantial Rehabilitation
rules.interaction_text: *The amount of relocation payments for temporary capital improvement evictions for less than 20 days is governed by California Civil Code Section 1947.9 and not by Rent Ordinance Section 37.9C.

rules.title: Relocation Payments for Ellis Act Evictions
rules.requirement: For Ellis Act eviction notices served 3/01/26 – 2/28/27, the relocation amount is $11,110.05 per tenant, up to $33,330.13 per unit, plus $7,443.90 for each elderly (62 years or older) or disabled tenant.
rules.key_value: $11,110.05 per tenant; maximum $33,330.13 per unit; plus $7,443.90 per elderly or disabled tenant
rules.coverage_text: Tenants evicted under the Ellis Act.
rules.quoted_span: Relocation payments for tenants evicted under the Ellis Act

rules.title: Relocation Payments for Temporary Displacement Less Than 20 Days
rules.requirement: For temporary capital improvement displacement of less than 20 days with notices served 3/01/26 – 2/28/27, the relocation amount is $446.00/day per tenant household plus actual moving expenses.
rules.coverage_text: Tenant households temporarily displaced for capital improvement work for less than 20 days.
rules.quoted_span: Relocation payments for temporary displacement for less than 20 days
rules.interaction_text: *The amount of relocation payments for temporary capital improvement evictions for less than 20 days is governed by California Civil Code Section 1947.9 and not by Rent Ordinance Section 37.9C.
